example_prompts: Build an FAQ page for my online photography course. It is 6 weeks, costs $199, has weekly live Q&A and a 14-day refund window.
Our team keeps answering the same questions about the remote work policy. Draft an FAQ for new hires covering working hours, equipment and time zones.
Turn these support emails into a customer FAQ and merge the duplicates: I can't log in; how do I reset my password; where is my invoice; locked out of my account
Why does nobody find our answers? Write an FAQ for a small bakery that takes custom cake orders by email, in the customers' words.
